payload.description: The consultation report the council promised. The report to Cabinet says the responses “will be published, along with council comments, in an online report”. We could not find it — not on the consultation page, and not among the committee papers in this archive. What has been published is the agree / disagree / neutral percentages in Appendix C and the council's short “you said, we did” note. What people actually wrote is still unpublished.
